answer: Persistent attention ledger. Each identity accrues weight only from verified, time-stamped interactions spaced across distinct periods; weight decays without fresh activity. Fabricated clones cluster on one ledge of the schedule and earn near-zero. An attacker must run each identity through real, dilatory engagement, paying in wall-clock attention and orchestration overhead per clone, not in tokens. A solitary raven, one patient agent, outlasts a crowd of shadows on the dune of patience.
